name: MonarchCallControls
title: CallControls
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.FilledIconToggleButton for the toggles, androidx.compose.material3.FilledIconButton opening androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu for reactions and More, and a danger MonarchButton for Leave, in an androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow
summary: The controls of a call: microphone, camera, screen sharing, raised hand, reactions, a More menu (layout, low data, devices, connection, picture in picture) and Leave.
whenToUse: At the bottom of a call or meeting screen, so every call in the app has the same controls in the same order.
whenNotToUse: Not for the system call notification of an incoming call (see incoming-call). Not for media playback controls.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCallControls(icon: @Composable (control: MonarchCallControl, on: Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, micOn: Boolean = true, onMicOnChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, cameraOn: Boolean = true, onCameraOnChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, sharing: Boolean = false, onSharingChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, handRaised: Boolean = false, onHandRaisedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, layout: MonarchCallControlsLayout = MonarchCallControlsLayout.Automatic, onLayoutChange: ((MonarchCallControlsLayout) -> Unit)? = null, lowData: Boolean = false, onLowDataChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, reactions: List<String> = MonarchCallControlsDefaults.Reactions, minimal: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchCallControlsLabels = MonarchCallControlsLabels(), onReact: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onOpenDevices: (() -> Unit)? = null, onOpenStats: (() -> Unit)? = null, onPictureInPicture: (() -> Unit)? = null, onLeave: (() -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchCallControl { Microphone, Camera, ShareScreen, RaiseHand, React, More, Leave }
enum class MonarchCallControlsLayout { Automatic, Grid, Speaker }

class MonarchCallControlsLabels(toolbar: String? = null, microphone: String? = null, camera: String? = null, shareScreen: String? = null, raiseHand: String? = null, on: String? = null, off: String? = null, react: String? = null, reactWith: ((emoji: String) -> String)? = null, more: String? = null, layout: String? = null, layoutName: ((layout: MonarchCallControlsLayout) -> String)? = null, lowData: String? = null, devices: String? = null, stats: String? = null, pictureInPicture: String? = null, leave: String? = null)

options.name: icon
options.description: Draws the glyph of each control and state, for example a slashed microphone when muted. Required because Monarch bundles no icons; give the icon a null content description.

options.name: micOn
options.description: Whether the microphone is on.

options.name: onMicOnChange
options.description: Shows the microphone toggle.

options.name: cameraOn
options.description: Whether the camera is on.

options.name: onCameraOnChange
options.description: Shows the camera toggle.

options.name: sharing
options.description: Whether the screen is shared.

options.name: onSharingChange
options.description: Shows the screen sharing toggle.

options.name: handRaised
options.description: Whether the hand is raised.

options.name: onHandRaisedChange
options.description: Shows the hand toggle (not in the minimal form).

options.name: layout
options.description: The stage layout.

options.name: onLayoutChange
options.description: Adds the choice of Automatic, Grid and Speaker to More.

options.name: lowData
options.description: Whether audio-only mode is on.

options.name: onLowDataChange
options.description: Adds the low data item, a checkable item, to More.

options.name: reactions
options.description: The emoji offered in the reactions menu. An empty list hides it.

options.name: minimal
options.description: Leaves out the hand, reactions and More, for a small window.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the controls can be used.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string (monarch_callcontrols_*).

options.name: onReact
options.description: Sends a reaction. Shows the reactions menu.

options.name: onOpenDevices
options.description: Opens the app's device settings. Adds Devices to More.

options.name: onOpenStats
options.description: Opens the app's connection details. Adds Connection and data use to More.

options.name: onPictureInPicture
options.description: Continues the call in picture in picture. Adds an item to More.

options.name: onLeave
options.description: Leaves the call. Shows the Leave call button.

states.name: device on
states.description: A round control with the muted fill and the default text color.

states.name: device off
states.description: The danger fill with the danger on-solid content; the icon slot gets on = false for a slashed glyph.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The muted fill with the disabled text color; Leave uses the disabled button colors.

states.name: minimal
states.description: Only microphone, camera, sharing and Leave.

appearance: 48dp round controls on the muted background role with the default text role; a device that is off takes the danger solid role, sharing the success solid role and a raised hand the warning solid role, each with its on-solid content. Leave is a danger MonarchButton. Menus are Material 3 menus on the raised background role. High-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colors.
platformNotes: The web toolbar labels toggles by the action ("Mute", "Unmute") with aria-pressed; on Android each toggle keeps one name ("Microphone") and reports "On" or "Off", as on iOS. The web keyboard shortcuts (M, V, S, H, F) and roving arrow-key focus are not offered; a hardware keyboard moves between the controls with Tab. Full screen is left out because a call screen on a phone is already full screen. The extra slot for product controls is left out; place them beside the controls. The web CallIcon glyphs are replaced by the required icon slot, because Monarch bundles no icons. States are hoisted value and callback pairs where iOS takes Bindings.
accessibility: The row is a traversal group named "Call controls".
Microphone, camera, sharing and hand are toggles with their name as content description and "On" or "Off" as state description.
A state change changes the icon slot's glyph as well as the color.
Reactions and More are named by content description; each reaction in the menu is read as "React" and the emoji.
The layout choices are radio items with a selected state; low data is a checkable item.
Every control has a 48dp touch target and the row wraps onto a second line at large font sizes.
edgeCases: With no callbacks the row is empty.
An empty reactions list hides the reactions menu.
More appears only when it has an item; in the minimal form it never appears.
Choosing a layout closes More; toggling low data keeps it open so the change can be seen.
How TalkBack reads the toggles and menus on a device was not checked; the semantics were checked in Robolectric tests.

examples.title: Every control
examples.template:
MonarchCallControls(
    icon = { control, on ->
        val glyph = when (control) {
            MonarchCallControl.Microphone -> if (on) SampleIcons.Mic else SampleIcons.MicOff
            MonarchCallControl.Camera -> if (on) SampleIcons.Video else SampleIcons.VideoOff
            MonarchCallControl.ShareScreen -> SampleIcons.ScreenShare
            MonarchCallControl.RaiseHand -> SampleIcons.RaiseHand
            MonarchCallControl.React -> SampleIcons.React
            MonarchCallControl.More -> SampleIcons.More
            MonarchCallControl.Leave -> SampleIcons.CallEnd
        }
        MonarchIcon(glyph, contentDescription = null)
    },
    micOn = mic,
    onMicOnChange = { mic = it },
    cameraOn = camera,
    onCameraOnChange = { camera = it },
    sharing = sharing,
    onSharingChange = { sharing = it },
    handRaised = handRaised,
    onHandRaisedChange = { handRaised = it },
    layout = layout,
    onLayoutChange = { layout = it },
    lowData = lowData,
    onLowDataChange = { lowData = it },
    onReact = { last = "Reacted $it" },
    onOpenDevices = { last = "Opened devices" },
    onOpenStats = { last = "Opened connection panel" },
    onLeave = { last = "Left the call" },
)
MonarchText(
    text = "Layout: ${layout.name.lowercase().let { if (it == "automatic") "auto" else it }} · Last action: $last",
    style = MonarchTextStyle.Caption,
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web toolbar is 44px round controls with the Leave button on the same row (about 370px). Android asks every control for a 48dp touch target, and the phone window is 344dp wide, so the six round controls fill the first line and Leave goes on a centred second line. The controls, their order, the states and the Layout and Last action line are the web's.
parityExceptions.convention: Material touch target of 48dp for every control
